description:
[Trading Data API] ENS lookup on Ethereum mainnet in either direction: name to address, or address to primary name.

**Example:** `/v1/chain-ens?name=vitalik.eth`

Use when you need to resolve an ENS name to an address, or an address to its primary ENS name. Not for non-ENS lookups.

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

address.description: Optional. An address to reverse-resolve to its primary ENS name.

name.description: Optional. An ENS name to resolve (e.g. vitalik.eth). Either name or address is required.

name: chain_ens
